verdict.rationale: Manufact hosts and manages MCP servers, so event triggers or webhooks from connected downstream apps are a fair question for it. The evidence only covers deployment triggers (on-demand deploys and deploy-on-push) and gateway request logs for observability. Neither is an event subscription an agent can register to receive downstream-app events instead of polling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
